facts.definition: One member is the current addressed or selected destination.
Every group must remain simultaneously visible rather than disclose locally.
Peer rows share one enclosing visual boundary.
The requested meaning is a protected brand mark rather than a product glyph.
A persistent assistant is normally available beside the addressed surface.
Persistent navigation normally surrounds the addressed surface.
Members form parent groups containing ordered descendants.
Members are destinations that move or switch the reader to addressed content.
Members are comparable siblings with no parent-child hierarchy.
The optional destination currently has no content it can reveal.
Access to the destination outcome is gated by entitlement.
The gated destination remains viewable as an explanatory or preview surface.
The destination must not receive activation in the current context.
Filtering acts only on the collection currently in the local surface.
Every hierarchical group carries completed and total progress.
Each parent group independently reveals or hides its descendants.
The destination collection must preserve keyboard traversal and activation.
The compact navigation form retains glyphs while visible labels are removed.
Navigation controls outside the repeating groups must remain visible while groups move.
The wide form is a persistent destination column beside routed content.
The repeating navigation groups exceed the available vertical region.
The narrow replacement switches local panels without changing route identity.
A narrow destination exists only while its backing content exists.
The persistent wide navigation becomes unreachable below its breakpoint without a replacement.
The narrow choices are peer destinations rather than primary actions.
A product meaning is stable enough to belong to the closed icon vocabulary.
The requested glyph is an ephemeral reaction rather than stable product vocabulary.
The region is the content panel inside a persistent resizable rail boundary.
The region stands beside the primary routed body in normal layout flow.
The region owns scrolling independently from the routed body.
The region covers rather than stands beside the underlying page.
The region survives changes to the routed body beside it.
The region is the primary addressed content plane for the route.
Overflow must move inside a bounded region rather than move the document.
At most one collection member is selected or current at a time.
The visible control shape is semantically a circle rather than a text capsule.
The addressed surface is an active evaluated or focused work session.
The focused surface owns the header and controls required during its live work.
The addressed surface is a result or score state after live work has ended.
The trailing fact is a non-zero count requiring timely attention.
The trailing fact must be visually distinguishable from quiet metadata.
The trailing fact communicates an entitlement lock.
The trailing fact communicates the viewer's ordinal rank.
The trailing count equals zero and carries no actionable signal.
The approved upstream icon vocabulary has no faithful glyph for the stable meaning.
The user can continuously resize the region within bounded width limits.
The user can switch the region between expanded and compact widths.
The addressed path contains at least three ordered steps.
The addressed path contains fewer than three ordered steps.
At least one ancestor before the current step exposes a legal navigation action.
No ancestor before the current step exposes a legal navigation action.
Each tab axis changes a different dimension of the same result and owns separate selection state.
The tab axis is a small closed peer set rather than an unbounded or remote option collection.
Tab labels may exceed the narrow inline measure while remaining one semantic label.
The arrangement must preserve its behavior across narrow and wide inline measures.
The axis has more than one enabled choice and can change the result.
A companion axis has at most one enabled choice and cannot change the result.
No axis has more than one enabled choice.
The payload is an authored markdown document whose block and inline structure is meaningful.
The content may contain headings, paragraphs, lists, quotes, code, tables or media blocks.
The content is constrained to inline text and cannot legally emit document blocks.
The content is a label or compact sentence allowing inline emphasis only.
The surrounding addressed surface already owns the document h1.
The authored document may contain code or tables wider than the reading column.
The authored document contains destinations requiring link classification.
The authored document contains section headings that form an outline.
A secondary navigation surface must expose authored section destinations.
The exact authored passages may be selected as grounded assistant context.
The prose surface must not participate in assistant selection grounding.
